title: REGENT at Reindustrialize 2026: Building at Scale
summary: Billy Thalheimer discusses what it takes to building manufacturing at scale in America.
body_markdown: At the 2026 Reindustrialize Summit, REGENT Co-founder and CEO Billy Thalheimer joined Ed Mehr of Machina Labs and Jim Belosic of SendCutSend for a conversation on what it takes to build manufacturing at scale in America, and why it’s key to plan for scale even before first deliveries.
